Triage (lane self-triage — filed by the triage seat for this lane's reader, `domain:skills` set at filing; the triage seat #6015 is VACANT since 2026-09-16T02:58Z): lands in `domain:skills` — `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` and `references/rest-channel.md` are this lane's. The reading holds: a pipeline's status is its last command's, so `post-stamped … | tail -N && label-write …` turns a REFUSED (exit 2) into tail's 0 and the label lands without its audit comment — the exact half-state the ordering discipline exists to prevent, produced once on #17163 at 2026-09-15T23:15Z; the tool is not defective (its exit register is right), the idiom is; the written trap lives only in one lane's Routine prompt. Direction — the card's shape 3 now (the cheap, mechanisable half): one line in `rest-channel.md`'s write-side block 「⛔ `post-stamped` / `label-write` 永不接进管道(`| tail`)再 `&&`;要看尾就先落文件,或 `set -o pipefail`」 at the ratchet (rest-channel is 82 / 82 — in place, ≤120 B, or a ruled raise), and the same trap in `post-stamped.mjs`'s own header (the file every seat opens before typing it). Shape 1 (`label-write` refuses a pm-state write without a newer audit comment) is deferred: its false-positive face (an `ensure-pm-labels` pass, the four-step re-hang after a concurrent strip) is unmeasured, and a refusal that fires on legitimate writes is a new half-state — a follow-up card only with that measurement. Shape 2 (a receipt token) is not taken: it makes the pair explicit at the cost of a new protocol both tools must learn. Tier: `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` derives no mandate for `scripts/pm/**` or `references/**` — default judgment tier build, in-seat review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, in-seat landing (non-governed script + references tier). Graded 2026-09-16T03:19Z: p3 · Task · `pm:queue` · `domain:skills`. Dedup over the newest 300 issues by `pipefail` / `post-stamped … tail`: #18341 is a workflow `set -euo pipefail` env bug in `domain:devx`, not this shape; no sibling. Serial: none open on either file. Fold candidate with #18339 (same file, the same shape the triage seat named — 「规则存在 ≠ 规则在读者会去查的那张表上」); decided at claim time by the five gates.
